assumptions.assumption: The overall 'average' benchmark is the mean institutional ownership across all rows with a non-missing instownpct, with no grouping. Rows with a missing eventannotm are included in this benchmark.
Rows with a missing eventannotm form their own group. Groups whose ownership values are all missing have no average and are excluded.
'How far above average they are on average' means the mean of (timing average minus overall average) across the qualifying timings.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-timing average ownerships, not the row-level mean.

assumptions.assumption: "Average" for the strictly-above test is the overall mean of instownpct across all non-null rows (row-level), not the mean of the group averages. A NULL eventannotm forms its own group, and NULL ownership values are ignored.
"How far above average" is the group's average minus the overall average, averaged across the qualifying timings.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-timing averages, so each timing group counts equally rather than each row.
